system.description:
As a part of the activation of this jutsu. The

target must currently be Incapacitated or willing. Over the course of a minute, you tattoo a seal on a target creatures’ tongue. You select 1 topic, which you wish for the target creature to be unable to speak of. Once this jutsu is casted the target creature becomes unable to speak, write, or willing reveal information on or about the topic you chose. A creature can attempt to undo the effects of this jutsu by making a Ninshou check against your Genjutsu Save DC + 5. An affected creature cannot gain a bonus to this check as the result of a jutsu. Each attempt takes 1 hour. On a successful check the target creature becomes able to speak on the topic freely again.
